## Important
- zzz-release/gate.py:5 — correctness — Accept approvals equal to the configured minimum — With two approvals and `minimum=2`, `approved(2)` returns `False`, although the docstring promises “at least the configured number of approvals” (`zzz-release/gate.py:1`). The new `>` comparison excludes equality. — A release meeting its configured approval requirement is blocked until an unnecessary additional approval arrives. — Fix: Restore `approvals >= minimum` and extend `test_approved_release` in `tests/test_release.py` to cover equality.
